note: Human source videos are publisher illustrations; EgoWE retains the explicitly labeled EgoVerse placeholder. Robot head-camera training episodes from the public 0917 dataset snapshot are selected for complete tasks and steadier camera motion. Scenes are carpet-free except the explicitly approved bimanual clothes demonstration. Only initial pre-action lead-in may be removed for web playback. These are training episodes, not evaluation demonstrations; the repository snapshot and paper training set are different variants.
